resources.string: Preview for supported Adreno OpenCL drivers; shown only after a device capability check. Requires the existing English-244 download and English-only keyboard locales. Other models use stock CPU. Prewarms while recording and keeps a loaded model for up to 5 idle minutes, unless memory pressure or Android releases it. A cold load may still take 20 seconds. Runs in a separate process; driver failures may end recognition. Stock FUTO is the default when off.
Faster decode when Experimental OpenCL GPU is on. May change accuracy or punctuation. Requires the English-244 download and English only. Off by default; stock CPU and normal GPU stay available.
